descriptionChirho: A gentilic adjective designating inhabitants of the Philistine city of Ashdod. Used as a collective singular with the article (ha-Ashdodi, Jos 13:3) to refer to the Ashdodite population as a whole, in the masculine plural (Ashdodim / ha-Ashdodim, 1 Sam 5:3, 6) for the men of Ashdod, in the feminine plural (Ashdodiyyot, Neh 13:23) for women of Ashdod, and with the conjunction (Neh 4:1) for Ashdodites as a group opposing the rebuilding of Jerusalem. All instances denote the same gentilic identity, with variations in number, gender, and syntactic context (with/without article, with conjunction) rather than distinct semantic senses.
